newsitem.title: CANADA: MDSI wins US$10 mln deal from AT&T.
newsitem.headline: MDSI wins US$10 mln deal from AT&T.

text.p: MDSI Mobile Data Solutions Inc said on Tuesday that it signed a contract worth US$10 million with AT&T Corp to install MDSI's Advantex-Telecommunications Work Force Management System.

The company said its Advantex system allows field technicians to communicate over a wireless network in order to update the status of their assigned work, initiate line tests from the field and access corporate customer databases and helping management of the mobile field service technicians to meet scheduled appointment windows.
